title: What's New: Power BI for Projects and Inventory (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Project Profitability and Sales by Type

features.name: Inventory Forecasting Report
features.description: New Power BI report that uses machine learning statistical models to forecast inventory needs based on past performance. Includes upper and lower bounds, trend lines, and filtering options by location, item, or item ledger entry type.
caveats: Forecasting is statistical machine learning, not generative AI
Results depend on quality of historical data
Requires proper parameter tuning for business type

features.name: Seasonality Control in Forecasting
features.description: Customizable seasonality settings in the forecast visual menu that allows users to adjust for one, two, or three seasonal patterns depending on business type, such as Christmas decorations or other cyclical sales patterns.
caveats: Requires manual configuration for each business type
Users must understand their business seasonality patterns

features.name: Project Power BI App Open Source
features.description: The Project Power BI application is now open source and ready for customizations. Users can tailor it to business needs, track progress more effectively, and surface insights for on-time and on-budget delivery.

features.name: Project Profitability Analysis
features.description: Enhanced Project Power BI reports with focused metrics on project profitability. New visual showing billable to invoice percentage and profitability measures by sales type and customer to track project profitability effectively.

features.name: Project Invoice Sales by Type
features.description: Power BI report showing project invoiced sales broken down by type, including resources, items, and GL accounts that can be sold through projects. Displays billable to invoice percentage and profitability measures by sales type.

features.name: Project Invoice Sales by Customer
features.description: Updated Power BI report for analyzing project invoiced sales by customer with billable to invoice percentage and profitability metrics. Allows filtering by customer to analyze profitability per customer from the project side.

features.name: Project and Inventory Analytics Landing Pages
features.description: Dedicated landing pages for analytics resources: aka.ms/bcinventory analytics for inventory analysis and aka.ms/bc project analytics for project analysis. These pages provide scenarios, personas, Power BI reports, and other resources.
